title: The Last Inventory
author: Ines Vane
blurb: Freya Coldharbour, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
